tasks.title: pr-status CLI
tasks.description: Zero-dep Node CLI gathering CI, CodeRabbit check state, GraphQL unresolved threads, rate-limit parse, reviewer states, idle time into one JSON snapshot.
acceptance: Emits schema-stable JSON with ci, coderabbit (checkState, unresolvedThreads, rateLimit), reviewers, idle
Unresolved-thread count comes from GraphQL reviewThreads filtered to CR + isResolved=false
Rate-limit parse returns resetsAt from a CR rate-limit comment

tasks.title: pr-status unit tests
tasks.description: Fixture-based tests for CR comment/rate-limit parsing and GraphQL unresolved counting.
acceptance: Tests cover CR comment shapes, rate-limit body parse, and GraphQL reviewThreads unresolved counting

tasks.title: rewire finalize to pr-status
tasks.description: Replace inline REST poll in finalize with calls to lib/pr-status.js; advance condition uses unresolved threads + terminal CR check.
acceptance: No REST-only comment count remains as the sole advance signal
